mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, username, password_hash, role, created_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, created_at FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, created_at FROM app_user WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
